_doc: hetz optional items for /hetz:setup global; unchecked unless "default": true. Same merge rules as safe.json. "requires"/"hide_if" name conditions computed by scripts/hetz_settings.py.

explore.label: Explore subagent on Haiku
explore.why: Writes ~/.claude/agents/Explore.md; a user agent named Explore overrides the built-in (verified 2.1.272). Delete the file to restore it.

statusline-wrap.label: hetz segment after your statusline
statusline-wrap.why: Keeps your statusLine command and appends the hetz meter; undo restores yours.
statusline-wrap.selftest: the status bar shows your line followed by `│ ctx …`

model-sonnet.label: Default model Sonnet
model-sonnet.why: About 2x cheaper per token than Opus; Opus stays one launcher (cc-deep) away.

launchers.label: Shell launchers cc/cc-deep/cc-quick/cc-spec/cc-do
launchers.why: Pick model and effort at session start instead of mid-session /model (which re-writes the cache).

read-cap.label: File Read cap 12k tokens
read-cap.why: CLAUDE_CODE_FILE_READ_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS=12000: big files must be read in ranges.

goal-checkin.label: No goal check-in turns
goal-checkin.why: CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES=0 stops periodic goal check-in requests.

advisor.label: Opus advisor
advisor.why: advisorModel opus: a cheaper main model consults Opus at decision points (Anthropic API only).
